desc: The ATI Alpha Maxx from the Gen3 series redefines the .410 Gauge platform with modern design and tactical functionality. Designed for home defense, tactical operations or recreational shooting, this shotgun combines lightweight construction with potent firepower. Featuring a 5+1 capacity, it strikes a balance between firepower and maneuverability, ideal for diverse scenarios. Equipped with a durable polymer stock, the Alpha Maxx maintains a lightweight profile while ensuring strength and comfort
